question: Does each family's committed output actually come from its own build script?

method.step1: SHA-256 every committed file in the family's output directory
method.step2: rebuild through the family's OWN owning script, invocation determined per script and confirmed empirically
method.step3: hash again; a differing rebuild is rebuilt a second consecutive time to separate instability from drift
method.step4: record which files differ, and whether the rebuild is richer or poorer in bytes and in lines
method.step5: restore the working tree with `git checkout -- <path>` and verify byte-identical restoration before the next family
method.ordering: every family in a proven state (COMPLETE_PACKET_PROVEN, VERIFIED_PASS) first, since those are the ones whose provenance is being relied on
method.note: this tool measures only; it repairs nothing it finds
